basic_details.job_title: Ratnagiri District Revenue Servant (Kotwal) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 9 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Tehsildar Office Rajapur Ratnagiri District has announced 9 temporary vacancies for the Revenue Servant (Kotwal) post, with offline applications to be submitted by hand or post to the Tehsildar Office Rajapur on or before 17 October 2026. Applicants can obtain the application form from Tehsildar Office Rajapur or via notice. Candidates must have passed the 4th standard to be eligible for the position. The notified pay for the post is Rs. 15,000 per month. The selection process for these temporary and ad-hoc appointments consists of a Written Exam followed by Document Verification.

selection_process: The selection process comprises a Written Examination consisting of objective multiple-choice questions (100 questions for 100 marks) covering General Knowledge

content_sections.heading: Ratnagiri District Revenue Servant (Kotwal) at a Glance
Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Obtain the application form from the Tehsildar Office Rajapur. Submit the filled-in application form along with required copies of documents either by hand or through post. Deliver the application to the Tehsildar Office Rajapur on or before 17 October 2026 by 5:45 PM (excluding public holidays during office hours).

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises a Written Examination consisting of objective multiple-choice questions (100 questions for 100 marks) covering General Knowledge, Mental Ability, Marathi, Mathematics, Science, History, Civics, and Ratnagiri District Knowledge, followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to submit the application for Ratnagiri District Revenue Servant (Kotwal) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 17 October 2026 by 5:45 PM.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Kotwal post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed at least the 4th standard.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Applicants must be between 18 and 40 years of age as per the advertisement date, with age relaxations applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. Is there a written examination for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, a written examination carrying 100 marks consisting of objective multiple-choice questions will be held on 15 November 2026.
